label: 4.10ct H VVS2 — promising 360, revised after ASET
commentary: A source-dependent reversal, not two separate stones. 0-0-0 initially considered this H's material cleaner-looking than the G in Loupe360 (#16). Karl_K thought its cut slightly more promising on limited comparison video (#17) and, once shown the controllable Loupe360, expected excellent movement without an obvious material concern (#19). After purchase, the buyer suspected leakage in ASET (#20); 0-0-0 suggested cleaning and positioning prongs near the corners to avoid artefacts (#21). The buyer still found the centre dark and insufficiently active after adjustments (#22). Karl_K then described the improved result as a miss and acknowledged the limits of 360-only assessment (#23); lovedogs agreed it disappointed (#24), and the buyer returned it (#25). This does not prove the eventual problem was detectable in the original supplier 360. The Loupe identifier LG524247250 is not independently verified as a certificate here.
